## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a conventional commit (for example `fix(app): ...`); it becomes the commit message on `main`
- [ ] `cargo fmt-check`, `cargo lint` and `cargo test --all-targets` pass
- [ ] No real personal data in tests or fixtures
- [ ] Docs and `AGENTS.md` are updated when behavior or layout changed
